name: Build a gated right-sized plan
prompt: Learner: /plan introductory statistics for two weeks. My goal is to interpret A/B test results at work. I know basic arithmetic but have not studied probability.

judge.check: The plan frames the target task, learner level, time constraint, and observable success evidence without asking a full intake questionnaire.
The plan includes only necessary prerequisites, labels their gate status, and provides 3 to 7 dependency-ordered main nodes.
Each node has an observable objective and guiding question, with likely misconceptions or exit evidence represented without turning the plan into a large syllabus dump.
The plan ends with one smallest useful next action.
